title: Tanker news share shorts FDX 3d
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] GDELT tanker GKG share 20d z-score > 1 raises jet-fuel and bunker cost fears for freight (-); trade short FDX 3d at 3d lag [gdelt.gkg.tanker_share -> finance.FDX.log_return]
message: Not a rule: short FDX on tanker-news z>1 loses pre-war (17 trades, hit 24%, excess -0.8%/trade) and only marginally works in war OOS (11 trades, hit 64%, +0.25%); r=-0.07 at lag 0, perm p=0.90, actionability 2.07.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.tanker_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short FDX next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] GDELT tanker GKG share 20d z-score > 1 signals jet-fuel cost shock that hits airlines harder than parcel freight (-); trade short JETS 3d at 3d lag [gdelt.gkg.tanker_share -> finance.JETS.log_return] (parent: R2-0066)
